exp-rational-halfline.scope: All retained polynomial and type-(0,n) reciprocal clauses are proved. The user-excluded type-(n,n) Halphen asymptotic is outside this family.

clauses.statement: Every polynomial degree has exact uniform best error one half for exp(-x) on the positive half-line and exp(x) on the negative half-line, expressed as the least attainable uniform bound.

The actual finite two-resolvent denominator has the displayed finite derivative formula and exact degree, and after x=4t is positive on the entire half-line with strictly positive derivative in positive degree.
The actual explicit reciprocal approximation has uniform error at most sqrt(40/21)/3^n, hence at most sqrt(2)/3^n, in every degree including degree zero.
The native canonical RatFunc type-(0,n) pole-free minimax infimum has geometric lower and upper bounds with the finite truncation prefactor; every finite degree has strictly positive error.
The actual type-(0,n) rational minimax error on the positive half-line has exact nth-root limit one third.

Affine reflection preserves the exact canonical rational error-bound set and its infimum, so the original atlas orientation exp(x) on the negative half-line has the same geometric bounds and exact nth-root limit one third.

For any finite real symmetric or complex Hermitian positive semidefinite matrix, including the empty size, the explicit denominator evaluates to a positive definite matrix and its inverse approximates the actual matrix exponential in spectral norm with the same dimension-independent scalar bound.

exp-rational-halfline.source: four_focused_mathematical_reroutes.tex Section 1 and retained reciprocal lower-bound appendix; open_mathematical_items_operator_derivations.tex RC1-RC10
exp-rational-halfline.proof_route: Finite Rodrigues Gram identities and weighted minimax lower certificate; explicit two-resolvent smoothing with exact kernel square norms; shifted monic-recurrence coefficient induction replaces the source Jacobi eigenvalue tail argument; canonical rational-function normalization and logarithmic sandwich prove the actual root limit.
exp-rational-halfline.trust: No new axiom, sorry, native_decide, certificate supplied as a hypothesis, or minimizer assumed on the noncompact half-line.
exp-rational-halfline.verification: All endpoint and support modules checked individually with Lean; root must run repository-wide build, Audit.lean, layer check, generated declaration/atlas checks before PR. This inventory records retained scope only and must not be installed as a full atlas proof family for the composite card.

abs-best-approx-asymptotics.scope: The retained polynomial Bernstein limit, positivity, finite degree transfer, and coarse enclosure are proved for the native polynomial minimax error. The user-excluded Stahl rational equivalent is outside this inventory; printed decimal digits of the Bernstein constant are not formally certified.

clauses.statement: Actual degree-bounded real minimizers exist, the even-degree Chebyshev comparison gives E_(2m) <= 2/(pi*(2m+1)), and symmetrization proves E_(2m+1)=E_(2m).

For each alpha in (0,1), every positive target degree compares to every sufficiently large even source degree via the actual finite polynomial scaling and an explicit exponentially decaying target-degree remainder.
The actual scaled native minimax error n*E_n converges along all integer degrees to the real constant defined by its even-degree liminf.

The actual finite modulated Fejer dual annihilates all competitors of the prescribed degree, has uniform functional norm at most one, and yields E_n >= 1/(18*pi*(n+1)). No dual certificate is assumed as a hypothesis.
The Bernstein limit is strictly positive and lies in [1/(18*pi),2/pi]; a positive constant with the full scaled limit therefore exists.

abs-best-approx-asymptotics.proof_route: Finite real polynomial minimizers, finite sine-coordinate growth and Bernstein-ellipse approximation, scalar degree-transfer liminf closure, and a genuine finite modulated Fejer integral lower certificate. No limiting entire function is required.
abs-best-approx-asymptotics.trust: No new axiom, sorry, native_decide, assumed dual certificate, or assumed minimizer.
abs-best-approx-asymptotics.verification: Fresh direct Lean checks of the positive enclosure and finite parity endpoint pass.
